'''December 2000 Lompoc tournament (16 December)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Lompoc, California on 16 December 2000. It is known from Cat Ceder's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1551">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-17-lompoc-again-12-16-00d1551/ lompoc-again-12-16-00], DeckTech (Cat "CatLoneRogue" Ceder, 17 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-17-lompoc-again-12-16-00d1551/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 16 December 2000
* '''Site:''' Lompoc, California
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 8
